title: Group Product Manager
job_description:
**Description**
---------------

Role Objective / Major Purpose of the Job Role Objective: To support the Product Management and Marketing team in planning, executing, and monitoring marketing activities, ensuring effective brand promotion, field support, and implementation of strategic initiatives. Principal Tasks & Responsibilities 1. Role Objective: To manage and deliver accurate MIS reporting, sales analytics, and operational coordination to support Sales & Marketing functions. The role ensures timely reporting, effective data analysis, and coordination with internal teams to support business decisions and improve operational efficiency. Principal Tasks & Responsibilities Key Responsibilities 1. Marketing Execution & Support Develop marketing collaterals, visual aids, and promotional materials as per brand requirements. Prepare presentations and communication materials for field force and internal stakeholders. Assist in creative campaign design and ensure proper implementation to strengthen brand image. Support product management in day-to-day activities, including data collation and reporting. 2. Sales Force & Field Support Provide training to sales teams on promotional strategies, USPs, and brand campaigns. Travel to field locations to oversee implementation of marketing programs and promotional activities. Facilitate KOL doctor visits, symposia, and CME programs, ensuring smooth coordination. 3. Financial & Performance Monitoring Prepare quarterly Profit & Loss statements to track and control budgeted costs per brand plan. Monitor marketing performance against set targets internally and externally. Ensure stock availability of promotional materials and samples at distribution centers. 4. Data & Analysis Conduct market research and competitor analysis to support brand strategy. Collect, analyze, and report marketing data to guide product planning and strategy decisions. 5. Cross-Functional Coordination Liaise with Sales, Medical, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to ensure smooth execution of marketing initiatives. Support coordination of CRM activities and key customer development initiatives. Key Skills & Competencies Strong product and therapeutic knowledge Understanding of pharma marketing strategies and campaign execution Market research and competitor intelligence Data analysis and reporting skills Cross-functional collaboration Knowledge of pharmaceutical compliance and ethical guidelines 1. MIS & Reporting Prepare daily, mid-month, 28th day, and monthly MIS reports for management and HOD. Generate stock availability reports against pending orders and coordinate with the field force. Prepare Primary and Secondary Sales reports and share with HO and field teams. Prepare CNS-wise and month-wise sales forecasts. Maintain and update sales, stock, and performance dashboards. 2. Sales Operations Support Prepare HO order requests and coordinate with Finance, Marketing, and Distribution teams. Track product shortages and follow up with the distribution department. Prepare Inter-Branch Transfer (IBT) reports for stock movement. 3. Field Coordination Coordinate with field staff for new stockist appointments and doctor appointments. Communicate with the field team regarding stock updates, sales performance, and targets. Respond to field queries and ensure timely resolution. 4. Financial & Administrative Support Support the annual budget preparation process. Monitor stockist credit limits and coordinate with relevant departments for revisions. Track overdue outstanding payments and coordinate with field teams for collections. Manage concurrence and documentation for payments including field activities, HO executive expenses, and tour claims. 5. Incentive & Performance Data Prepare incentive raw data and share with the SFE department for further processing. Track weekly and monthly target achievements and report performance updates. 6. Process Improvement Ensure adherence to SOPs and internal processes. Simplify reporting systems and improve MIS efficiency. Provide accurate reports, analysis, and presentations to management and internal stakeholders. Key Skills & Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and data reporting tools Knowledge of CRM / ERP systems (SAP, Salesforce, etc.) Ability to manage large datasets and generate insights High attention to detail and accuracy Effective communication and coordination skills Understanding of pharmaceutical sales operations and reporting

author: Hiring Manager
title: Assistant Product Manager
job_description:
#### **Role Overview**

We are looking for a sharp, data-driven, and user-obsessed **Associate Product Manager** to join our product team. As a fresher or recent graduate with strong SQL and analytical capabilities, you will work directly with Senior Product Managers, Engineering, Design, Credit/Risk, and Operations teams to build and optimize seamless digital financial journeys, from customer onboarding and KYC to loan disbursals and repayments.

#### **Key Result Areas (KRAs) & Responsibilities**

* **Data Extraction & Funnel Analytics (SQL-Driven):** Write complex SQL queries to pull product telemetry, analyze customer drop-offs across onboarding, e-KYC, credit underwriting, and payment funnels, and identify high-impact friction points.
* **Requirement Gathering & Documentation:** Assist in writing clear Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria backed by data insights for mobile app and web features.
* **Experimentation & Metric Tracking:** Define success metrics, build self-serve dashboards, and track post-launch feature adoption, conversion rates, and retention cohorts.
* **Cross-Functional Execution:** Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers, tech leads, and QA teams during sprint planning, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and product releases.
* **Compliance & Risk Alignment:** Work alongside Risk, Fraud Control (FCU), and Compliance teams to ensure product flows adhere to RBI digital lending guidelines and data security standards.

#### **Eligibility & Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (B.Tech/B.E., BBA, B.Com, Economics, Statistics, MBA, or related quantitative fields) , **2025 or 2026 graduates only**.
* **Prior Exposure (Preferred):** Internships, live projects, data/product case study competitions, or academic projects involving SQL querying, product analytics, or fintech workflows.

#### **Skills & Competencies**

* **Strong SQL Proficiency (Must-Have):** Hands-on ability to write clean, efficient SQL queries (joins, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, and aggregations) to independently analyze large transactional and user-event datasets.
* **Analytical & Quantitative Mindset:** Comfort with Excel/Google Sheets and interpreting product/fintech metrics (funnel conversion, TAT, cohort retention, approval rates).
* **Product Sense:** Strong user empathy, wireframing basics (Figma/Balsamiq), and the ability to break complex financial workflows into simple user steps.
* **Communication & Agility:** Ability to translate raw data and business requirements into structured documentation for engineering teams while thriving in a fast-paced environment.

title: Product Manager – AIOD
job_description:
Company Description

AIOD helps Shopify merchants reduce the operational effort of running sales and promotions. Trusted by 2,000+ brands, AIOD simplifies discount setup, free gifts, promotional storefront updates, and discount abuse prevention.

Role Description

We're looking for a hands-on Product Manager who owns product outcomes, not just roadmaps and PRDs. Your primary responsibility is to improve AIOD's install-to-paid conversion, merchant activation, and retention.

Responsibilities

- Analyze customer support conversations and product usage data

- Speak directly with merchants to understand their problems

- Identify friction across onboarding, activation, and subscription funnels

- Design and run experiments to improve conversion

- Work closely with engineering to ship impactful improvements

- Measure the actual business impact of every feature and experiment

Qualifications

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Ability to translate customer problems into product opportunities

- Comfortable with product analytics, funnel analysis, and experimentation

- Strong ownership and execution skills

- SaaS or D2C / e-commerce experience is a plus.

Work Setup

- Full-time, remote (WFH)

- Work directly with the founders

- High ownership and hands-on execution.

Work Location: Remote

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Product Manager**

**Location:** Sector 32, Gurgaon, Haryana  
**Role Type:** Full-time, Work from Office  
**Experience:** 3–8 years of direct & relevant experience  
**Industry Preference:** EdTech, Education SaaS, Content-Tech, NGO, CSR, or Development sector  
**1. About iDream Education**  
**Vision:** Unlimited Learning. Unlimited Growth. For Everyone.  
**Belief:** We believe that access to learning and growth is a fundamental right, and that learning in its truest sense is the joyful unfolding of a being’s fullest potential — in all dimensions of life.  
**Mission:** To deliver solutions and experiences that facilitate access to learning and growth for everyone, irrespective of their languages, geographies, abilities, curricula, age groups, learning styles, and socio-economic status.iPrep by iDream Education is a Learning Platform that runs both offline & online, is bilingual and works on all major hardware devices and operating systems. iPrep delivers curriculum-aligned digital learning for classes 1st to 12th in English, Hindi, and Regional language mediums for universal reach and learning use as:• iPrep Digital Class for Smart Classrooms• iPrep Digital Library for Tablets/Notebooks based Smart ICT Labs• iPrep PAL for Personalised Adaptive Learning• iPrep Tablets for Preloaded Learning Devices with Monitoring• iPrep App for a one-stop learning platform across Android, iOS, and WebThrough iPrep, iDream Education empowers teachers and students, both in schools and at home to **Learn Unlimited.**Company website: **www.idreameducation.org** | iPrep website: www.iprep.in

**2. Role Summary**  
The Product Manager at iDream Education sits at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and the field. You will define what gets built, ensure it is built right, and make sure it solves real problems for the students, teachers, and administrators who use our products every day.You will work across both internal tools and the iPrep suite of products — partnering closely with design, engineering, ops, content, and sales, as well as with field counterparts — leading roadmap planning and prioritisation in close partnership with the founders.

**3. Key Responsibilities & Deliverables**

**Own the Spec Layer**

* Translate requests from ops, content, sales, and marketing into clear, structured product requirements before they reach engineering.
* Define acceptance criteria, timelines, and priorities for every piece of work entering the engineering pipeline.
* Eliminate ambiguity as a default — no ticket moves to development without a written spec.

**Bridge Design and Engineering**

* Work closely with the design team to drive iterations to finality — own sign-off gates so engineering always builds against confirmed designs.
* Be the single point of accountability for design-to-development handoffs.
* Reduce rework by making design decisions explicit and time-bound.

**Stakeholder Interface**

* Be the primary point of contact for internal teams — ops, content, sales, marketing — channelling their needs into the product process.
* Interface with field counterparts and school-level stakeholders to surface ground realities and unvoiced user needs.
* Represent product context clearly across very different audiences — from engineers to field coordinators.

**Roadmap Planning and Prioritisation**

* Lead roadmap planning in close partnership with the founders — synthesising inputs from internal teams, field signals, and usage data.
* Identify unvoiced opportunities: gaps that no one is articulating yet but that the data or field context reveals.
* Work with our data analysts to bring usage evidence into prioritisation discussions — not just instinct.

**4. Qualifications & Experience**

**Education:** Graduate in any discipline; a background in Product Management, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field is preferred. However, candidates with a strong track record in product management, product strategy, or cross-functional product development will also be considered regardless of their specific degree.  
**Experience:** 3–8 years of experience in Product Management, preferably in a technology, SaaS, EdTech, or digital product environment. A proven track record includes successfully defining product requirements, collaborating with cross-functional teams, driving product launches, and delivering measurable business and user outcomes through data-driven product decisions.

**Other Requirements:** Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet product delivery timelines. Strong collaboration with engineering, design, business, and other stakeholders is essential. This is primarily an office-based role located in Gurugram, Haryana, with minimal travel as required for customer interactions, workshops, or business meetings.

**5. Key Skills & Competencies**

* 3–8 years of total relevant experience, with at least 1–2 years directly in a product team (as PM, Associate PM, Business Analyst, or similar adjacent role).
* You have been a member of a product team — you understand how good product development works from the inside, even if PM wasn’t your exact title.
* You write with structure and clarity. Your specs, briefs, and updates leave no room for misinterpretation.
* You are comfortable with data — you can pull the right numbers, read them honestly, and use them to make a case or change your mind.
* You thrive in environments where influence matters more than authority. You can align people who don’t report to you.
* You are energised by working closely with founders — you see it as an advantage, not a constraint.
* You genuinely care about the problem: quality education reaching every child, regardless of where they grow up.
* You are coachable and self-aware — you know what you don’t know, and you’re not threatened by it.

**6. What We're Looking For — Values & Culture Fit**

* **Integrity:** Makes transparent, data-driven product decisions and takes ownership of outcomes.
* **Impact:** Builds products that solve real customer problems and drive measurable business value.
* **Excellence:** Continuously improves the product through user insights, data, and innovation.
* **Collaboration:** Works seamlessly with cross-functional teams to deliver successful product outcomes.

**7. Why Join Us**  
This is a high-ownership role at the center of our product development, where your work directly bridges the gap between field realities and engineering execution. You will partner closely with the founders to shape the roadmap of the iPrep suite, ensuring our products solve real-world problems for students and teachers across India. Join us to build, measure, and scale solutions that make "Unlimited Learning" a reality for every child, while advancing your product leadership in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What is your current CTC ?
* what is your notice period ?
* what is your current location ?
* what is your expected CTC?

Experience:

* Product management: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

job_description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Digital Product Manager

**In this role, you will:**

* Participate in a variety of functions within the digital environment
* Identify opportunity for digital business plans, programs and initiatives within scope of responsibilities
* Review and analyze basic content strategy/creation, customer experience, analytics/research or product management
* Exercise independent judgment to guide medium risk deliverables
* Present recommendations for resolving more complex situations
* Exercise independent judgment while developing expertise in the on digital initiatives, policies, procedures and/or compliance requirements
* Collaborate and consult with digital consultants and managers on more complex digital initiatives, including internal/external customers if applicable

**Required Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of digital product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Posting End Date:**

26 Nov 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

c. Please be prepared to provide accurate information and supporting documentation in connection with any lawful employment and education verification conducted by Wells Fargo.

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Position: Senior Product Manager

Location: Mumbai

Working Days: Monday to Friday

Experience Required: 7+ years

**Senior Product Manager**
==========================

**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**

the client powers some of India's biggest live event on-sales. As we grow, the consumer app needs one senior owner who ties discovery, buying and retention into a single product. You'll set the direction for the app, lead a team of product managers and ship with design and engineering. Expect high ownership, quick decisions and short paths to users.

**WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO**

App and Discovery

* Own the homepage and app experience, so every visit reflects who the user is and what's next for them
* Build personalised discovery, from playful onboarding to recommendations people act on
* Work with the Shadow lead on how our AI agent fits into the app

Transactions and Growth

* Make the buy flow (event page, seat maps, checkout, referral) faster and more reliable on every device
* Own downloads, retention, engagement and loyalty, with metrics you set and report on

Team & Collaboration

* Lead and grow a team of product managers
* Partner with design, engineering and marketing across Mumbai and Bangalore

**WHAT YOU BRING**

*Specific experience, not vague credentials*

Required

* 7+ years in product, with at least 3 owning a consumer app end to end
* Built consumer apps at scale in India
* Owned a checkout or buy flow where conversion and reliability both mattered
* Moved retention or engagement, and can explain what worked and what didn't
* Managed product managers or APMs

Preferred

* Experience in live events, ticketing, entertainment, travel or a similar consumer category
* Shipped an AI or conversational product to real users
* Personalisation or recommendations work: onboarding, user profiles, ranked feeds
* Campaign-led app experiences built with marketing

**NON-NEGOTIABLES**

You've owned a consumer app's numbers, not just its features. This role is judged on retention and conversion, not output.

You've led product managers. You'll run a team from day one, with no time to learn people management on the job.

You write clearly. Specs and decisions move between two cities; if they need a call to be understood, work stalls.

You take direction and push back with evidence. You'll work closely with a strong design lead, as a partner rather than an order-taker.

You're based in Mumbai and can travel to Bangalore regularly. The team works across both cities.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
TripleLift is the Creative SSP powered by TL Spark, our agentic intelligence layer. We orchestrate creative, supply, audience, and measurement into a single outcome-driven system across the open internet, retail media, and CTV. Our platform enables brands and agencies to drive measurable performance while helping publishers maximize yield and preserve high-quality user experiences.

**Overview**
------------

The Product Manager plays a critical role in driving product development and delivery within the Product team, directly influencing how we serve advertisers and publishers on TripleLift's award-winning technology platform. In this position, you will partner closely with Engineering, Design, and client-facing teams to shape product roadmaps and ensure seamless execution from concept through launch. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who wants to own a meaningful part of a fast-growing ad tech platform, work at the cutting edge of advertising and emerging channels of online content consumption, and grow into a product leader.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own the vision and roadmap for your product area, building alignment with cross-functional partners and contributing to TripleLift's overall product strategy
* Work with Design and Engineering to define requirements, develop products, and plan their phasing and rollout
* Support product commercialization in collaboration with Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Solutions, Client Services, and others
* Become an expert in the business of our customers and an advocate for their needs as we evolve our company and product
* Use data and evidence to inform decisions, prioritize ruthlessly, and measure product success
* Help establish product best practices and weave them into the fabric of excellence at TripleLift

**Education & Requirements**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a scientific discipline, or equivalent experience
* Minimum of 2 years of product management experience required, with experience at a technology company highly desired
* Minimum of 1 year in ad tech with a solid understanding of the ad tech ecosystem and its players
* Specialization in video, CTV, or mobile advertising is a plus
* Ability to articulate a clear product vision and enlist others behind your ideas
* Initiative and hustle; you get things done where others would have given up
* Commitment to backing your ideas with data and evidence
* Strong prioritization skills and willingness to cut scope
* Critical eye combined with a can-do, problem-solving attitude
* Ability to make complex concepts clear and accessible to others
* Engineering experience is a plus

At TripleLift, we believe great work starts with great people. We foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to making each other better. We move with urgency, challenge convention, and continuously innovate to elevate digital advertising. We value people who bring new perspectives, take ownership, and work together to drive meaningful impact. Learn more about TripleLift and our culture on our LinkedIn Life page.

Please review our Privacy Policy for information about how TripleLift handles personal information.

*TripleLift does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment search firms. Any resume submitted without a signed agreement in place will become the property of TripleLift, and no fee will be due.*

job_description:
Product Manager – Consumer Product

**Company:** Be10x  
**Department:** Product – Engagement, Retention & Growth  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Work Location:** As per company requirements

Job Overview

Be10x is looking for a **Product Manager** to own a core domain of our consumer product **end-to-end**.

This is a high-ownership role where you will be responsible for taking products from **problem discovery and ideation to strategy, roadmap, development, launch, measurement, and continuous optimisation**.

You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and Product leadership while being accountable for business outcomes such as **engagement, retention, activation, and conversion**.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the **product/domain end-to-end**, from identifying customer problems to delivering measurable business outcomes.
* Define product vision, strategy, roadmap, priorities, and success metrics.
* Conduct product discovery using user research, behavioural data, and business insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey, engagement, retention, activation, and conversion.
* Analyse funnels, cohorts, user journeys, and product performance to identify drop-offs and growth opportunities.
* Create clear **PRDs, product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria**.
* Work closely with Engineering and Design teams to plan, build, launch, and iterate features.
* Make product prioritisation and trade-off decisions based on customer value and business impact.
* Drive the complete product lifecycle: **Discovery → Strategy → Roadmap → Development → Launch → Measurement → Optimisation**.
* Design and run **A/B tests and product experiments** and use learnings to improve the product.
* Monitor product KPIs and continuously optimise product performance.
* Align cross-functional teams and stakeholders around product direction and priorities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* **3–5 years of Product Management experience** in a **B2C / consumer digital product**.
* Proven experience in **end-to-end product ownership**.
* Ability to independently own a product/domain and drive it from **problem identification to measurable business results**.
* Strong understanding of **Product Strategy, Product Vision, Product Roadmapping, Product Discovery, and Product Execution**.
* Strong **product sense** and ability to identify high-impact customer problems.
* Strong **data-driven decision-making** and product analytics skills.
* Hands-on experience with **Mixpanel, Amplitude, Google Analytics, or similar product analytics tools**.
* Strong understanding of **funnels, cohorts, user journeys, engagement, retention, activation, and conversion metrics**.
* Experience with **A/B testing, experimentation, hypothesis-driven product development, and iteration**.
* Strong skills in writing **PRDs, product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria**.
* Strong **prioritisation and stakeholder management** skills.
* Ability to make product trade-offs based on **customer impact, business value, data, and technical feasibility**.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to align **Engineering, Design, Product, and Leadership**.
* Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams to **ship products/features from concept to production**.
* Ability to take complete ownership of problems and drive them to resolution **without requiring constant supervision**.
* Comfortable working in a **fast-paced Agile product development environment**.

Nice to Have

* Experience in **EdTech, E-learning, LMS, or consumer learning products**.
* Experience in **Growth, Lifecycle, Engagement, or Retention Product Management**.
* Experience working on **customer acquisition and activation funnels**.
* Experience shipping products across **Web and Mobile (iOS/Android)**.
* Experience working in a **high-growth consumer technology/product company**.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who **owns outcomes, not just a backlog**.

You should be comfortable taking a problem, understanding the customer, defining the right solution, building the roadmap, working with Engineering and Design, launching the product, analysing results, and continuously improving it.

**End-to-end ownership of the product is a core requirement for this role.**

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹300,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in consumer product company??

Experience:

* Product management: 3 years (Required)
* End-To-End ownership of the Product: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

**About the role**

We are looking for a Product Manager to own key parts of our digital lending platform. You will

shape how customers discover, apply for and receive credit products.

You will work closely with engineering, design, risk, marketing and lending partners. The goal is to

build reliable, scalable products that grow the business and improve the customer experience.

**Key responsibilities**

Product strategy and roadmap

* Define the product vision and roadmap for your area, aligned with business goals.

* Prioritize features based on customer needs, data and business impact.

* Write clear PRDs and define success metrics for every launch.

Partner and platform integrations

* Own integrations with lending partners such as banks and NBFCs.

* Work with engineering to design APIs, data flows and verification systems.

* Ensure platform reliability through monitoring and alerting.

**Growth and optimization**

* Identify growth opportunities across the customer funnel.

* Run experiments and A/B tests to improve conversion and retention.

* Use data to optimize marketing spend and customer targeting.

**Platform improvement**

* Improve existing systems for speed, scalability and ease of experimentation.

* Reduce manual work through automation and internal tools.

Collaboration and leadership

* Lead cross-functional squads using Agile practices.

* Mentor junior product team members.

* Share progress and results with senior leadership.

**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Engineering or a related field.

* 4–6 years of total work experience, with at least 3 years in product management.

* Experience building products in fintech, lending, credit cards or consumer

marketplaces.

* A track record of launching products that delivered measurable business results.

* Experience working with engineering teams on APIs, integrations or platform systems.

* Strong communication skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders.

* Product Technical Analytics
* Roadmapping SQL Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
* PRDs Python Tableau
* User research APIs Microsoft Clarity

* System design fundamentals
* Core competencies: ownership mindset, data-driven decision making, stakeholder management,

* Familiarity with KYC, digital verification and underwriting workflows in India.

* Experience modernizing legacy platforms.

* Experience managing or mentoring a small team.

* Flexible schedule

We are seeking a **Product Manager** with extensive hands-on experience in full cycle of Product planning, stakeholder management, product management, market research along with expertise in Agile.

**What you’ll do**

* Responsible (together with the startup’s CEO/CTO) for defining, driving, and communicating the product vision, goals, outcomes, and roadmap across the startup to keep everyone coordinated and prevent any silos.
* Managing and overseeing the entire product discovery and delivery lifecycle from strategic planning through tactical execution. Work very closely with the Project Manager, so that schedule and delivery never spill from the planning.
* Identify and prioritize key product features, functions, and enhancements based on market research, customer feedback, and internal stakeholders' input.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to define requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Conduct user research, usability testing, and customer feedback analysis to validate product features and identify areas for improvement.
* Partner with customer success to identify and resolve customer issues and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Manage product backlog, prioritize tasks, and maintain the product backlog in JIRA or similar project management tools
* Continuously looking for ways to improve our way of working and collaborating with our other product managers to ensure we are always growing

**Your qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in product management for SaaS products.
* Strong understanding of agile methodologies and product development lifecycle.
* Experience with user research, market research, and data analysis.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to present ideas and information clearly and effectively.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to inform product decisions.
* Experience with JIRA or similar project management tools.
* Passion for delivering excellent products and a desire to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Experience in B2B SaaS and/or enterprise software.
* Experience with design thinking methodologies.
* Focus on outcomes and quality of output
* Empathetic and team player
* Driven, hard work ethic showing commitment

**Behavioural:**

Here are five essential behavioural skills a Product Manager should possess:

* **Effective Communication:** Clearly and concisely convey ideas, requirements, and feedback to team members, stakeholders, and clients, fostering an environment of open dialogue and mutual understanding.
* **Leadership and Mentorship**: Inspire and guide the development team, providing support and encouragement, while promoting a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
* **Problem-Solving Attitude:** Approach challenges with a proactive mindset, quickly identifying issues and developing innovative solutions to overcome obstacles.
* **Collaboration and Teamwork:** Work well within a team, encouraging collaboration and valuing diverse perspectives to achieve common goals and deliver high-quality results.
* **Adaptability and Flexibility:** Stay adaptable in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, effectively managing changing priorities and requirements while maintaining focus on project objectives.

**What you’ll get in return…**

Joining Taazaa Tech means thriving in a dynamic, innovative environment with competitive compensation and performance-based incentives. You'll have ample opportunities for professional growth through workshops and certifications, while enjoying a flexible work-life balance with remote options. Our collaborative culture fosters creativity and exposes you to diverse projects across various industries. We offer clear career advancement pathways, comprehensive health benefits, and perks like team-building activities.

**Who we are**

Taazaa Tech is a kaleidoscope of innovation, where every idea is a brushstroke on the canvas of tomorrow. It's a symphony of talent, where creativity dances with technology to orchestrate solutions beyond imagination. In this vibrant ecosystem, challenges are sparks igniting the flames of innovation, propelling us towards new horizons.

Welcome to Taazaa, where we sculpt the future with passion, purpose, and boundless creativity

title: Product Manager, GPay
job_description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 7 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from concept to launch.
* Experience with Growth in a fast paced environment (especially in Consumer facing Mobile first areas).
* Experience and interest in building large-scale platforms.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

As a Product Manager leading the Transit and Mobile Recharge verticals within Google Pay (GPay) India, you will own the overall direction, strategy, and execution for two of GPay's highest-frequency engagement drivers. In this role, you will define end-to-end product roadmaps across daily-commute transit experiences as well as Mobile Recharge product strategy and growth across - Platform, AI experiences, UX, performance and more. You will serve as the core strategic owner bridging product innovation, internal cross-functional execution (Engineering, UX, Analytics, Legal, Business Development), and critical external ecosystem partnerships with Telecom companies, Aggregators, regulators, public transport operators, and more to scale daily and monthly usage and engagement amongst users across India.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define and execute the multi-year product strategy for Transit and Mobile Recharge verticals on GPay India, translating complex daily utility needs and regulatory standards into intuitive, high-scale GPay experiences.
* Lead the end to end product portfolio across Growth, Platformization, Scalability, Reliability, Obsersability, AI experiences and new opportunities at massive scale.
* Lead buildout of the Transit space on GPay —driving initiatives across NCMC, QR Ticketing and other first-party and third-party experiences.
* Establish a close working relationship with key ecosystem partners (NPCI, Bharat Connect, aggregators, issuers and others) to navigate compliance , unblock technical dependencies, and lead cross-functional growth tracks to eliminate funnel friction and maximize user engagement.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Team**

Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.

Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us.

We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.

But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.

### **What will you do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
* Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.

### **What you will need**

* Overall experience of 7+ yrs with atleast 5+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

### **About us**

Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.

**Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.**

### **Our Mission**

Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.

We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.

Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.

### **Culture and Total Rewards**

Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.

Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.

We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.

To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.

At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the **Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016**, we uphold the following principles:

* **Equal Opportunity**: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
* **Accessible Workplace**: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
* **Inclusive Hiring Process**: We adopt a transparent and non-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.
* **Career Growth**: We provide adequate training post-recruitment and pre-promotion, with training materials available in accessible formats to enable equal career progression.
* **Support & Confidentiality**: A dedicated liaison officer/committee addresses concerns and grievances, while maintaining strict confidentiality of disability-related information.
* **Awareness & Inclusion**: We conduct awareness programs to promote a culture of inclusivity across the organization.

Meesho welcomes applicants and employees of all abilities and is dedicated to fostering an environment where differently abled persons can achieve their full potential.

Know more about Meesho here : https://www.meesho.io/

job_description:
Job Opening: Regulatory Affairs Officer

**Bionova Research Labs Pvt. Ltd. – Bengaluru**

**Location:** Yelachenahalli, Bengaluru  
**Experience:** 5–10 Years  
**Industry:** Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals  
**Qualification:** B.Pharm / M.Pharm / M.Sc. or relevant qualification

**Key Responsibilities**

* Independently handle FSSAI and Drugs & Cosmetics regulatory compliance.
* Manage FSSAI, Drug Control and CDSCO licensing, approvals, renewals and statutory submissions, as applicable.
* Review pharmaceutical and nutraceutical formulations for regulatory compliance.
* Verify ingredient permissibility, dosage limits, product classification and claims.
* Approve packaging artwork, labels, promotional materials and advertisements.
* Handle regulatory inspections, notices, queries and corrective actions.
* Maintain regulatory documentation, compliance trackers and monthly MIS.
* Coordinate with R&D, QA/QC, Production and Marketing teams.
* Monitor regulatory amendments and ensure timely implementation.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Strong hands-on experience in BOTH FSSAI and pharmaceutical regulatory affairs is mandatory.
* Extensive experience working in pharmaceutical and nutraceutical manufacturing companies.
* Practical knowledge of FoSCoS, Drugs & Cosmetics regulations, labelling and product approvals.
* Experience dealing independently with FSSAI and Drug Control authorities.
* Ability to assess formulations and approve regulatory compliance without external dependency.

**Preferred:** Candidates experienced in third-party manufacturing, new product development and regulatory audits.

**Reporting To:** Head – Legal, Regulatory Affairs & Corporate Governance

**Working Days:** Monday–Saturday  
**Timings:** 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM

**Important:** Candidates experienced in only FSSAI or only pharmaceutical regulatory affairs will not be considered.

Pay: ₹535,000.00 - ₹650,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager, Toll.OS (Tolling, ITMS and ATMS)_MPIN
job_description:
**Company Description**

**Purpose of the role**

Bosch Mobility Platform and Solutions (MPS) builds software platforms and digital services for the mobility ecosystem: tolling and traffic, logistics and fleets, commerce and marketplaces, financial services, and the cloud and data platform that runs underneath them. MPS works with partners and customers across India, Europe and North America, and operates like a digital-native business inside Bosch.

Toll.OS is the open-road tolling and traffic platform of Bosch MPS for Indian highways. It combines RFID and FASTag reads, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and sensors into one verified transaction, and it runs on a layered architecture from the roadside edge to back-office reconciliation. It is live on a national highway today and is designed to scale from one gantry to many corridors.

The Toll.OS play also covers intelligent traffic management and enforcement at junctions and corridors, and the integration of tolling with highway Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS) as national highway authorities specify in their tenders. The Product Manager owns this play as a product: what is built, how it performs in the field, what it costs to run, and what it needs to win the next deployment.

 **Job Description**

**What the role owns**

**Product strategy and roadmap** - Own and evolve the roadmap across tolling (multi-lane free flow and plaza software), intelligent traffic management and enforcement, and integration with highway ATMS. Sequence work by customer need, economics, certification effort and regulatory readiness.

**Field learning into requirements** - Work from live deployments: recognition accuracy, manual validation rate, reconciliation gaps, notice and dispute failures, incident root causes. Turn each pattern into a prioritised backlog item with an owner.

**Recognition and sensor-fusion quality** - Define accuracy and confidence targets across RFID, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and other sensors. Work with engineering and AI teams on model, camera and edge decisions, and lead make-or-buy choices on components.

**Interoperability, compliance and security** - Ensure the product meets national interoperability specifications for electronic toll collection, RFID and equipment standards, certification requirements, data protection, audit logging and retention. Work with Legal and Compliance on regulatory change.

**Tender and bid support** - Own the technical content of responses to highway authority and concessionaire tenders: compliance matrices, equivalence of components, architecture and service-level proposals. Work with Finance on bid-versus-investment discipline.

**Deployment and operations readiness** - Define site readiness, integration with acquirer banks and payment networks, settlement and reconciliation, service-level design and acceptance criteria. Hand over cleanly to operations and keep the live KPIs visible.

**Unit economics** - Own cost per passage and cost per plaza, and shape transaction-fee and service models with Finance, so the product stays competitive in price-led tenders.

**Ecosystem and partners** - Work with highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and hardware vendors. Work with the Global Partner Manager on technology and supplier partnerships.

**Platform and data integration** - Publish passage and vehicle events into the Mobility Prism platform so the same vehicle can be understood across tolling, traffic and other services, within consent and data protection rules.

**Team and ways of working** - Guide the product owners and engineering squads working on Toll.OS using agile (SAFe) practices, and build the product-management discipline of the team through coaching and clear decision records

**How the role is measured**

The role is accountable for business outcomes, not only for product documentation. Effectiveness is assessed on:

* Recognition accuracy and share of passages verified without manual review
* Time from field issue to product fix
* Cost per passage and cost per plaza trend
* Technical compliance rate and win rate on tenders the role supported
* Deployment lead time from contract to go-live
* Reconciliation and settlement accuracy with acquirer banks
* Number of corridors and plazas running on the standard product
* Quality of field feedback captured into the roadmap

 **Qualifications**

**Who we are looking for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (electronics, electrical, computer science, civil or transportation); a master's degree or MBA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8 to 12+ years in product management, systems engineering or programme leadership in intelligent transport systems, electronic toll collection, smart-city or transport technology, payments infrastructure or computer-vision based systems.
* Has owned a product or system through design, certification, field deployment and operation, and has seen how it behaves when real traffic arrives.
* Experience in public-sector or regulated procurement (tenders, compliance matrices, service-level and performance guarantees) is strongly preferred.

**Domain and technical knowledge**

* Electronic toll collection: FASTag and national electronic toll collection specifications, RFID standards, acquirer and issuer roles, settlement and reconciliation.
* Number-plate recognition, computer vision and sensor fusion; understanding of accuracy metrics, confidence cascades and model monitoring.
* Edge computing, plaza and back-office systems, and integration through APIs; familiarity with traffic management and enforcement systems is an advantage.
* Certification, equipment standards, cybersecurity and data protection as they apply to roadside systems.
* Able to read an architecture, challenge a design and translate field problems into engineering requirements.

**Commercial skills**

* Unit economics, pricing and service-level commercials; comfortable with a P&L view of a product.
* Negotiation and relationship skills with authorities, banks and vendors.

**Personal attributes**

* Strong ownership and bias to action; comfortable operating with ambiguity in a new business.
* Field-minded: willing to spend time at sites and with operations teams, with regular domestic travel.
* Clear structured communicator, in writing and in the room, who can explain a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
* Integrity and discretion when working with public authorities and sensitive data.
* Collaborative leader who influences without formal authority across engineering, business and partners.

 **Additional Information**

**Who the role works with**

* Product Area Leader for the UtilizationStack (MPS/PAZ)
* Engineering, AI and DevSecOps teams
* Delivery, site and operations teams
* Bid and tender team, and the Global Partner Manager
* Finance, Legal and Compliance
* Regional business leadership (MPS/RBR)
* Highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and vendors
* Product owners for Mobility Prism and for financial services built on toll data

**How to read this role**

This is a product-ownership role with business accountability, not a project management or pure engineering role. The ideal candidate combines systems depth, field experience, commercial judgement and the ability to win trust with authorities and partners.

job_description:
**Job Description :**

**About us**

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

**About the Function:**

  

Our Digital and Technology (D&T) team are innovators, delivering ground-breaking solutions that will help shape the future of our iconic brands. Technology touches every part of our business, from the sourcing of sustainable ingredients to marketing and development of our online platforms. We utilise data insights to build competitive advantage, supporting our people to deliver value faster.

Our D&T team includes some of the most talented digital professionals in the industry. Every day, we come together to push boundaries and innovate, shaping the digital solutions of tomorrow. Whatever your passion, we’ll help you become the best you can be, creating career-defining work and delivering breakthrough thinking.

**About the role:**

Lead the engineering capability required to build and evolve reliable Commercial data solutions using reusable patterns, automated controls and product-aligned delivery. The role is accountable for engineering quality, delivery discipline and technical outcomes; product priorities and business value remain with product owners.

**Core skills required on a broader prospective -**

Years of exp - 3 to 10 years

  

Below technical capabilities the Analytical Product Manager/Owner need to possess the areas marked as #1 is non-negotiable in context of requirements:

Data & Analytics Foundations (#1)

* SQL proficiency for querying, validating and exploring data
* Understanding of data modelling (star/snowflake schemas, dimensional modelling)
* Familiarity with KPI design, metric definitions and semantic layers
* Statistical literacy (A/B testing, significance, forecasting basics)

Data Platforms & Architecture ( Foundational understanding of aspects as part of Product/Solution Architecture and its implications)

* Knowledge of modern data stacks: cloud data warehouses and lakehouses (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure Synapse/Fabric)
* Understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines and orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory)
* Awareness of data integration from ERP/CRM sources (e.g. SAP, Salesforce, Workday)
* APIs and data exchange principles

BI & Visualisation (previous experience required as this is capabilities/capacity would be provided from BI Transformation & Self-Service pillar)

* Hands-on experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik)
* Dashboard design and data storytelling best practice
* Self-service analytics enablement

Data Governance & Quality (#1)

* Data quality frameworks, lineage and cataloguing (Collibra, Informatica, Alation)
* Master data management principles
* Data privacy and regulatory awareness
* Access control and security models

Advanced Analytics & AI (#1)

* Understanding of machine learning lifecycle and MLOps concepts
* Ability to scope predictive and prescriptive use cases
* Awareness of GenAI applications in analytics

Product Management Tooling & Methods (#1)

* Agile/Scrum delivery and backlog management (Jira, Azure DevOps)
* Writing user stories, acceptance criteria and data requirements
* Product roadmapping, prioritisation frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW)
* Product usage analytics and adoption tracking

Business Translation & Thought Leadership (#1)

* Functional use case formulation: identifying, defining and shaping analytics use cases with business functions (e.g. Supply Chain, Finance, Commercial)
* Translating business problems into technical requirements (BRDs including NFRs)
* Thought leadership: shaping the analytics vision for functional analytics products, advocating data-driven decision-making in context of the process the product is supporting and bringing an informed view on industry trends and emerging capabilities to evolve the product offering
* Value measurement and benefits tracking for analytics products
* Stakeholder management across business, GBS Data Office and GBS Product experience Towers

ML or GenAI solutions

Data science

**Worker Type :**

Regular

**Primary Location:**

Bangalore Karle Town SEZ

**Additional Locations :**

**Job Posting Start Date :**

2026-11-19

title: Assistant Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Title: Assistant Product Manager**

**About SEEDS**

Sustainable Environment and Ecological Development Society (SEEDS) is a leading non-profit organization working towards making communities resilient to the impact of disaster risks through various innovative approaches, working in disaster management for over 30 years. As you may be aware, SEEDS has been awarded the Sasakawa Award for Disaster Risk Reduction 2022 by the United Nations and the most prestigious Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar 2021 by the Hon’ble Prime Minister of India. It continues to empower the most vulnerable across Asia to build a better future. For more information, visit www.seedsindia.org

Role Purpose

Support the Product Manager in implementing, enhancing and maintaining organizational technology platforms, translating approved business requirements into functional deliverables, coordinating technology development partners, and ensuring effective testing, deployment and user adoption.

Scope of Work

1. **Technology platform implementation:** Support the implementation, enhancement and maintenance of ERP, CRM and other organizational digital platforms.

2. **Requirements and documentation:** Work with the Product Manager and internal stakeholders to gather requirements and prepare functional requirement documents (FRDs), workflows, process maps and technical documentation.

3. **New technology partner onboarding:** Identify and assess prospective technology development partners; coordinate technical discussions, proposal evaluations, scope finalization, contractual processes and project kick-off activities.

4. **Development partner coordination:** Coordinate with existing and new partners on development, testing, deployment, timelines, deliverables and maintenance.

5. **Product development support:** Translate approved BRDs and solution designs into functional requirements, development tasks and implementation plans in coordination with the Product Manager.

6. **Testing and quality assurance:** Coordinate UAT, maintain bug and issue trackers, document feedback and follow up with development partners until resolution.

7. **Process improvement and automation:** Identify operational gaps and recommend technology-driven improvements, including AI-based solutions and workflow automation.

8. **Dashboards and reporting:** Develop and maintain dashboards, reports and automation using Advanced Excel and other digital tools.

9. **Technology research:** Research and evaluate emerging technologies, AI solutions and digital platforms for organizational use.

10. **Training and documentation:** Prepare SOPs, user manuals and training materials, and conduct user training sessions.

11. **Platform monitoring:** Monitor platform performance, track implementation progress, maintain project trackers and recommend continuous improvements.

12. **Cross-functional coordination:** Coordinate with internal departments and external partners to support timely delivery of digital initiatives.

13. **System integration and data management:** Support system integrations, data management and digital transformation initiatives across the organization.

14. **Technical support:** Troubleshoot user issues and coordinate resolution with technology partners.

Pay: ₹781,000.00 - ₹1,030,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Product Manager - AI Platforms, Director
job_description:
Closing date for applications: 04/12/2026

Location Gurugram, India

Job typePermanent | Contract typeFull Time

#R-00288180

  

**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------

In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.

So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.

**Job description**
-------------------

This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.

Join us as a Technical Product Manager - AI Platform

  
  

* You’ll be responsible for managing the development and implementation of technology-driven products
* The role focuses on understanding customer needs, overseeing the product lifecycle, and collaborating with technical and non-technical teams to ensure successful product delivery that aligns with business objectives
* You’ll gain valuable senior stakeholder exposure as well as the opportunity to hone your technical talents and leadership skills
* We're offering this role at director level
  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

We’ll look to you to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of technology products, from roadmap ownership and feature prioritization to launch and post-release evaluation. You’ll ensure strategic alignment through clear documentation and effective stakeholder communication, while proactively managing risks and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

  
  

You’ll also provide technical guidance to engineering teams, articulate customer pain points, and define performance metrics to measure success. We’ll also look to you to lead and mentor team members, supporting hiring efforts, and enabling agile decision-making to maintain momentum and
  
deliver impactful, customer-centric solutions.

  
  

Additionally, you’ll be:

  
  

* Delivering a product roadmap that aligns with business objectives and technological advancements
* Ensuring effective communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Leading the product development lifecycle from concept to delivery with a high-performing engineering team
* Making data-driven decisions that improve product performance and user satisfaction
* Providing regular reporting on product performance, development progress, and market trends
  

  

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------

  
  

We’re on the lookout for a strategic thinker with a passion for technology and innovation. You’ll have extensive experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field with strong leadership abilities, capable of motivating and influencing cross-functional teams.You’ll need at least seventeen years of total experience, with strong expertise in setting product vision, defining product strategy and roadmaps, and aligning development with strategic outcomes.

  
  

You’ll bring extensive experience in designing large-scale cloud architectures and distributed systems across AWS, GCP, and Azure, along with deep expertise in GenAI platform architecture, agentic systems, cloud-native technologies, and hands-on platform engineering. You’ll also be experienced in creating financial forecasts for products and features, contributing to platform-level budgeting, and driving focus and efficiency through disciplined prioritisation and agile decision-making.

  
  

You’ll also have:

  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in project management tools and Agile or Scrum methodologies
* Familiarity with software development processes and technologies
* The ability to work in a fast-paced environment

**Welcome to our Gurugram hub**
-------------------------------

Spanning 437,000 sq. ft., our campus in Gurugram features two state-of-the-art towers – 1A and 2A at the Candor TechSpace in Sector 21.

### **Key facts:**

* Surrounded by 28 acres
* Space for 4,100 colleagues
* Opened in 2010

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager - IT
job_description:
**Role:** Product Manager - IT
  
  
**About Us:** Scrubsy is India's #1 foam-based household cleaner – trusted by thousands of families for kitchen, bathroom, footwear, and all-purpose cleaning. We're a fast growing D2C brand under BoldChem Science Pvt. Ltd., scaling rapidly across Amazon, our own website, and quick commerce platforms. We are a funded organization. We move fast, we care deeply about quality, and we're building the team that is passionate!
  
  
**Brief:** We're looking for a Product Manager - IT to own the discovery, design, and delivery of internal tools and systems that make the business run more efficiently. This role sits between business teams and engineering identifying manual or inefficient processes, defining requirements, and driving internal products from concept through adoption.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
Identify manual, inefficient, or error-prone internal processes across teams and translate them into internal tool or automation opportunities
  
Own the product lifecycle for internal tools discovery, PRDs/requirement documents, prioritization, execution, and adoption tracking
  
Define Statements of Work (SOWs), Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), and success metrics for internal tooling initiatives
  
Partner closely with teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications and manage delivery timelines
  
Drive cross-functional alignment across stakeholders to scope and prioritize process-improvement projects
  
Track and report measurable impact of shipped tools
  
Manage risks, timelines, and resourcing for internal product initiatives; proactively flag scope or timeline changes to stakeholders
  
Continuously gather feedback and identify the next set of improvement opportunities
  
Maintain documentation, status reporting, and dashboards
  
  
What We Are Looking For
  
  
Mandatory Requirement
  
  
4+ years of experience in Product Management or a closely related role
  
Proven track record of building or managing internal tools, automation, or process-
  
improvement initiatives with measurable business impact
  
Demonstrated experience writing PRDs, SOWs, or detailed requirement documents and driving them through to delivery
  
Strong cross-functional stakeholder management experience
  
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, or a related field
  
  
Additional Requirement
  
  
Experience in e-commerce, D2C, or consumer tech product management
  
Exposure to AI/ML-driven features
  
Working knowledge of tools such as JIRA, SQL, Power BI/Google Analytics, or similar product/data tooling
  
  
Who You Are
  
  

* Proactive – you spot inefficiencies before they become problems and solve them
* Ownership Driven – you take complete ownership of your products, from identifying the problems to driving execution and adoption
* Detail Oriented – you pay attention to the details that can make or break a product, process, or user experience
* Curious – you constantly ask Why, explore better ways of working, and look for opportunities to automate and improve

**. Skillset Required:** Product Management, Internal tools, Automation, Process improvement, Business impact measurement, PRD writing, Statement of Work (SOW) writing, Requirement documentation, Cross-functional stakeholder management, E-commerce product management, D2C product management, Consumer tech product management, AI/ML-driven features, JIRA, SQL, Power BI, Google Analytics, Data tooling, Proactive problem solving, Product ownership, Attention to detail, Process automation
