author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager -Order Management (B2B)
job_description:
**Full Time**

Job Code: P-69693

Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

1 position

Expires on 23/11/2026

Required Experience

**2 - 6 Years**

Skills

**B2B,**

**OMS,**

**SAP**

+ 2 more

**Job Description**

At Purplle, we sell beauty and personal care brands across general trade (GT), modern trade (MT) and e-commerce. We
  
are building the sales and order management platform that every one of those channels depends on, from order to cash.
  
The core objective is simple: create real, measurable value for our sales, finance and supply chain teams by making every
  
order faster to place, easier to approve and more accurate to fulfil.
  
You will join as a Product Manager owning this platform end to end, from problem discovery through launch and
  
adoption.
  
This is a high-impact, zero-to-one role.
  

* You will own the roadmap and backlog of the platform and its ERP integrations (such as SAP HANA), working with

engineering, finance, supply chain and sales teams.
  

* You will turn real channel complexity (credit limits, pricing, schemes, stock allocation, approvals, returns) into clear

product requirements.
  

* Your work will directly drive order accuracy, order-to-invoice turnaround, fewer manual approvals and cleaner

handling of sales returns and credit notes.
  
Key responsibilities
  

* End-to-End Ownership: Own the platform from discovery and PRDs through design collaboration, build oversight,

launch and adoption.
  

* Roadmap & Outcomes: Own the roadmap and backlog, prioritising by business impact across GT, MT and

e-commerce teams. Define what success looks like for every feature at kick-off and instrument for it: own outcomes,
  
not just output.
  

* Sales Cycle Ownership: Own the end-to-end flow from order capture through credit checks, approval, ERP posting,

invoicing and dispatch.
  

* Sales Returns: Own the sales return and credit note flow: return reasons (expiry, damage, short shelf life, wrong

delivery), approvals, and how returns reflect in the ERP and stock.
  

* Channel Needs: Understand how sales processes differ across GT, MT and e-commerce, and build products flexible

enough to serve each of them.
  

* ERP & Integrations: Work with ERP and integration teams on how orders, inventory, pricing and returns flow

between the ERP, the platform, other portals and third-party tools.
  

* Iterative Delivery: Run a disciplined delivery cadence with engineering: validate direction early, correct fast, and ship

surgically once something is approved.
  

* Discovery & Stakeholders: Talk to sales, finance and operations users to find gaps; turn ambiguous business

problems into build-ready PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  

* KPI Ownership: Own order accuracy, order-to-invoice and approval turnaround, order failure and rejection rates, and

sales return turnaround.
  

* Live Support & Access: Be the first line of support for live issues (triage, root cause, fix) and define role-based access

so each user sees only what they should.
  
What we are looking for
  

* 2-3 years of B2B product management experience, with genuine end-to-end ownership of a product area (not just

feature delivery), ideally on internal tools, order management or sales and supply chain operations platforms used by
  
multiple user groups.
  

* Strong understanding of how FMCG sales works across GT, MT and e-commerce, including how primary, secondary

and tertiary sales work in GT (company to distributor, distributor to retailer, retailer to consumer), plus credit limits,
  
schemes, MRP and pricing.
  

* Clear understanding of the full sales cycle: order, approval, invoicing, dispatch, and sales returns and credit notes.
* Basic understanding of ERP sales modules (such as SAP SD: sales orders, deliveries, billing, returns) and hands-on

experience with integrations between the ERP, internal portals and third-party tools.
  
  

* Systems thinking: comfortable reasoning about platforms with multiple integrated modules, dependencies and

stakeholders rather than isolated features.
  

* Strong PRD and user story writing: well-scoped, edge cases covered, precise acceptance criteria, and low-fidelity

wireframes.
  

* Hands-on delivery management: independently runs stand-ups and sprint ceremonies, keeps the JIRA backlog clean

and surfaces blockers the same day, and validates early and corrects fast.
  

* Working knowledge of SQL, and comfort reading order, failure and return data to find problems and measure impact.
* Strong stakeholder management: aligns sales, finance, tech and external partners, and pushes back on requirements

when needed.
  

* Very high ownership and clarity of thought: breaks a problem into small, actionable items and, once direction is

given, leads from the front to closure.
  

* Curiosity, bias toward action and openness to feedback.

Good to have
  

* Hands-on experience with an order management system (OMS), B2B order flows or a distributor management

system (DMS).
  

* Exposure to ERP systems such as SAP HANA, and API-based integrations with external portals.
* Experience with credit limit, pricing and scheme, inventory, approval or returns workflows.
* BI tools such as Looker, Tableau or Metabase.

What you will gain
  

* True end-to-end ownership of a business-critical product, from discovery through launch and adoption.
* Hands-on experience building a high-volume, multi-user platform with complex system integrations.
* Direct visibility and working relationships with senior business and technology leaders.
* A clear growth path, with your scope expanding as your impact grows.

About Company

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.

In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.

In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

author: Hiring Manager
role: Technical Product Manager - AI Platforms, Director
role_title: Technical Product Manager - AI Platforms, Director
title: Technical Product Manager - AI Platforms, Director
job_description:
Closing date for applications: 04/12/2026

Location Bangalore, India

Job typePermanent | Contract typeFull Time

#R-00288180

  

**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------

In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.

So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.

**Job description**
-------------------

This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.

Join us as a Technical Product Manager - AI Platform

  
  

* You’ll be responsible for managing the development and implementation of technology-driven products
* The role focuses on understanding customer needs, overseeing the product lifecycle, and collaborating with technical and non-technical teams to ensure successful product delivery that aligns with business objectives
* You’ll gain valuable senior stakeholder exposure as well as the opportunity to hone your technical talents and leadership skills
* We're offering this role at director level
  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

We’ll look to you to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of technology products, from roadmap ownership and feature prioritization to launch and post-release evaluation. You’ll ensure strategic alignment through clear documentation and effective stakeholder communication, while proactively managing risks and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

  
  

You’ll also provide technical guidance to engineering teams, articulate customer pain points, and define performance metrics to measure success. We’ll also look to you to lead and mentor team members, supporting hiring efforts, and enabling agile decision-making to maintain momentum and
  
deliver impactful, customer-centric solutions.

  
  

Additionally, you’ll be:

  
  

* Delivering a product roadmap that aligns with business objectives and technological advancements
* Ensuring effective communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Leading the product development lifecycle from concept to delivery with a high-performing engineering team
* Making data-driven decisions that improve product performance and user satisfaction
* Providing regular reporting on product performance, development progress, and market trends
  

  

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------

  
  

We’re on the lookout for a strategic thinker with a passion for technology and innovation. You’ll have extensive experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field with strong leadership abilities, capable of motivating and influencing cross-functional teams.You’ll need at least seventeen years of total experience, with strong expertise in setting product vision, defining product strategy and roadmaps, and aligning development with strategic outcomes.

  
  

You’ll bring extensive experience in designing large-scale cloud architectures and distributed systems across AWS, GCP, and Azure, along with deep expertise in GenAI platform architecture, agentic systems, cloud-native technologies, and hands-on platform engineering. You’ll also be experienced in creating financial forecasts for products and features, contributing to platform-level budgeting, and driving focus and efficiency through disciplined prioritisation and agile decision-making.

  
  

You’ll also have:

  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in project management tools and Agile or Scrum methodologies
* Familiarity with software development processes and technologies
* The ability to work in a fast-paced environment

**Welcome to our Bangalore hub**
--------------------------------

Located at Taurus 4, Bagmane Constellation Business Park, our new office stands as a state-of-the-art hub for innovation and collaboration.

### **Key facts:**

* A 30 acre campus
* Space for 6,000 colleagues
* Opened in 2025

job_description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

Job Description- Principal Product Manager

**1. Role Overview**  
The Principal Product Manager for Corporate Intelligence will lead the product strategy and evolution of PRISM, Sabre’s corporate travel intelligence and decision-support platform. The role sits at the intersection of airline corporate sales, travel data, analytics, contracting, APIs and AI, and requires a strong understanding of how airlines use corporate travel data to make commercial decisions. This leader will own the evolution of the portfolio from traditional reporting and analytics toward predictive and prescriptive intelligence, helping airline customers improve corporate sales performance, contract effectiveness, market share and return on invested discounts. The role requires senior-level product leadership to connect customer and market needs with technology, data and commercial strategy

**2. What THIS ROLE Will Do**  

* Define and drive the Corporate Intelligence product vision, strategy, investment priorities and multi-year roadmap, balancing customer commitments, platform modernization, competitive differentiation, revenue protection and new growth opportunities.

* Drive capabilities that will transform the product to predictive and prescriptive intelligence, including contract optimization, forecasting, scenario modeling, AI-assisted insights and intelligent recommendations.

* Partner directly with airline corporate sales, commercial and revenue teams to understand complex problems around corporate contracting, market share, account performance, discount effectiveness and revenue opportunities, then translate those needs into scalable product capabilities.

* Shape capabilities across data ingestion, data quality, APIs, analytics and integrations, including agency/TMC connectivity, NDC and direct channels, CRM integrations and the modernization of customer access to Corporate Intelligence data.

* Partner with Engineering, Data Science, AI, Commercial, Customer Care, Delivery and Data Governance teams to take capabilities from strategy through delivery and adoption. Support strategic customer engagements, renewals, RFPs and new-business opportunities while ensuring the roadmap remains scalable rather than customer-specific.

**3. What THIS ROLE Requires**

* 10+ years of relevant product, travel technology, airline commercial, data or analytics experience, including demonstrated ownership of complex B2B or enterprise software products. Experience operating at Principal Product Manager or equivalent strategic product-leadership level is strongly preferred.

* Deep airline and corporate travel domain knowledge, with a strong understanding of corporate sales and contracting, TMC/agency ecosystems, airline distribution, GDS/NDC/direct channels, ticketed travel data, O&D concepts, market share, corporate account performance and commercial analytics.

* Strong data and technical product acumen, with the ability to work effectively with APIs, data pipelines, cloud/data platforms, data-quality concepts, analytics, CRM integrations and large-scale transactional datasets. The candidate does not need to be an engineer, but must be capable of translating business problems into technically credible product requirements and architecture discussions.

* Advanced analytics and AI product understanding, including predictive analytics, optimization, machine learning and Generative AI. The role must be able to identify where AI can materially improve airline commercial decision-making while ensuring data quality, explainability, governance and human oversight.

* Strategic and commercial product leadership, with demonstrated experience developing product strategy, prioritizing roadmaps and investments, building business cases, supporting enterprise customers and RFPs, and aligning senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Commercial and customer organizations.

**4. Why Join Us**  
The role combines strategic product leadership with direct customer and commercial impact. You will work across Product, Engineering, Data Science, AI and Commercial teams and engage with airline customers. This is an opportunity to influence the broader evolution of Sabre’s Corporate Intelligence portfolio and how trusted data and AI are converted into measurable customer and business outcomes.

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

title: Sr Advanced Tech Product Owner
job_description:
Honeywell is charging into the Industrial IoT revolution with the establishment of Honeywell Connected Buildings (HCB), building on our heritage of invention and deep, on-the-ground industry expertise. HCB is the leading industrial disruptor, building and connecting software solutions to streamline and centralize the assets, people and processes that help our customers make smarter, more accurate business decisions. Moving at the speed of software, we are creating, innovating and delivering solutions fast, challenging the way things have always been done, piloting new ways for all of us to work, and expecting our successes to set new standards for our customers and for Honeywell.

  

YOU MUST HAVE

* Business analysis in a complex and Cross-Functional Stakeholder environment

* Overall 6+ years of software development experience

* 4+ years’ experience in Agile development environments as a Product Owner/Business Analyst

* Knowledge of supervisory domain in HVAC

* Proficient in multiple Agile frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, design thinking, UX, and other frameworks

* Proven ability to apply analytical and critical thinking skills to solve, or lead the solving of, strategic problems of high complexity on a large scale

WE VALUE

* Expert stakeholder management and commercial acumen to link both business and technical functions across a broad portfolio / large stakeholder group

* Collaboration, respect, openness, continuous learning, and immense pride in doing good work.

* A collaborative, team-oriented approach and excitement about working on a multi-functional, global team with a passion for the development craft

  

Key Responsibilities:

* Consult with product stakeholders to understand business drivers and translate them into functional and non-functional requirements

* You will work with Product Managers to evaluate the product Roadmap to identify features for development and identify "definition of done" for each feature

* Lead robust, fast (through) inceptions (identify scope, value, solution and release plan) and Own prioritized actionable backlogs

* Manage scope and drive trade-off decisions in conjunction with external stakeholders while balancing business requirements with technical requirements

* Elicit, capture, analyze, refine and document business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and other technical documentation

* Research and analyze industry trends and benchmarking information as they apply to the HCE business model and domain area needs

* Dissect high-level information into details and communicate details in a manner understood by relevant audiences

* Attend standups, grooming meetings, estimation meetings, retrospectives and other key meetings for the scrum team

* Co-own Release Plans and communicate changes to stakeholders regularly

* Follow complete lifecycle of project benefit, including reporting back on adoption, business value and customer satisfaction post go-live

* Identify blockers that will impact timeline, scope, cost or other product variables and escalate to the appropriate stakeholders

* Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

role_title: S2B Product Manager, Statements & Reporting, Digital Channel Solutions
title: S2B Product Manager, Statements & Reporting, Digital Channel Solutions
job_description:
Requisition Number: 66516

Job Location: Chennai, IND

Global Grade: Band 5

Work Type: Office Working

Employment Type: Permanent

Posting Start Date: 18/11/2026

Posting End Date: 06/12/2026

:

**Job Summary**
---------------

* Own the product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for corporate client Statements, Advice and Transactional Reporting across S2B Web, Host-to-Host, SWIFT and API channels.

• Develop a coherent omnichannel reporting experience that enables clients to discover, configure, receive, download and reconcile account information consistently, regardless of the channel used.
  
• Drive convergence of reporting journeys, data definitions, formats, entitlements and service standards across channels, while accommodating channel-specific client needs and integration models.
  
• Translate client, business, regulatory and servicing needs into secure, resilient and scalable prior-day and intraday reporting capabilities, using client usage analytics to improve adoption, simplify the estate and guide lifecycle decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Product Strategy, Vision and Roadmap**  
• Define and maintain the global product vision, target-state architecture principles and multi-year roadmap for statements, account reporting, transaction reporting and advices across digital channels.
  
• Prioritise investments using client value, adoption, revenue enablement, regulatory obligations, service risk, architecture health and total cost of ownership; develop business cases and measurable outcomes.
  
• Benchmark market capabilities and emerging standards, converting insights into differentiated propositions and sequenced capability increments.

**Client Reporting Proposition and Standards**  
• Own the catalogue of prior-day and intraday statements, debit/credit advices, balance and transaction reports, including channel availability, eligibility, formats, service levels and client-facing documentation.
  
• Guide support for relevant reporting standards and formats, including SWIFT MT940/MT942, ISO 20022 camt.052/camt.053/camt.054, BAI2, CSV, PDF, XML and API payloads, with clear versioning and migration plans.
  
• Ensure consistent semantics, reconciliation behaviour, balances, value dates, transaction codes, references and data lineage across Web, H2H, SWIFT and API delivery.
  
**End-to-End Product Ownership and Agile Delivery**  
• Convert strategy and client needs into epics, capabilities, user stories, acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements; own backlog ordering and make transparent scope and trade-off decisions.
  
• Lead discovery, solution shaping, design reviews, sprint planning, demonstrations, UAT, release readiness, production rollout and benefits validation with Technology, Architecture, Operations and servicing teams.
  
• Embed security, privacy, entitlement, auditability, accessibility, performance, availability, scalability and observability requirements from inception.

**Client Experience, Adoption and Commercialisation**  
**• Use research, servicing insights and journey mapping to simplify report discovery, subscription, configuration, scheduling, delivery, download and exception handling.**  
**• Partner with Sales, Implementation, Client Service and country/cluster teams on client propositions, complex solutioning, migration, launch communications, training and adoption campaigns.**  
**• Define and monitor success measures such as active clients, report delivery and download utilisation, migration progress, digital adoption, service availability, failure rates, latency and client feedback.**

**Data, Architecture and Service Resilience**  
**• Maintain an accurate current-state view of source systems, data flows, transformation rules, interfaces, loaders, schedulers and upstream/downstream dependencies, including ownership and service levels.**  
**• Drive convergence toward reusable data services and a common reporting architecture across Cash and, where relevant, Trade and FSS, reducing duplication and inconsistent client outcomes.**  
**• Own product response to incidents and recurring defects, ensuring root-cause analysis, corrective actions, resilience improvements and prioritisation of technical debt and single points of failure.**

**Risk, Governance and Lifecycle Management**  
**• Operate product governance across new capabilities, material changes and report retirement, including approvals, client impact assessment, migration, records retention, regulatory and compliance review, and operational readiness.**  
**• Maintain product standards, controls, risks, dependencies, decision records and audit evidence; ensure issues are escalated and remediated with clear ownership and closure criteria.**  
**• Use usage and cost analysis to identify reports for growth, consolidation or decommissioning, validating recommendations with product, country, technology, operations and client stakeholders.**

**Stakeholder Leadership and Decision Making**  
**• Act as the accountable product subject-matter expert, aligning senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Sales, Implementation and Client Service.**  
**• Communicate complex data and technology topics clearly to executive and delivery audiences; facilitate decisions, resolve competing priorities and maintain momentum across globally distributed teams.**  
**• This is an individual-contributor Product Owner role with matrix leadership responsibility across multidisciplinary delivery teams and strategic partners.**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

**Must-have Skills**  
**• Digital Product Strategy and Lifecycle Management**  
**• Transaction Banking Statements and Reporting**  
**• Agile Product Ownership and Backlog Management**  
**• Data Architecture, Integration and ISO 20022/SWIFT Standards**  
**• Risk, Controls and Operational Resilience**  
**Other Skills**  
**• Client Experience, Commercialisation and Adoption**  
**• Data Analytics and Product Performance Management**  
**• Stakeholder Management and Executive Communication**  
**• Service Management, Incident and Problem Management**  
**• Market and Competitive Analysis**

**Motivations**
---------------

* **Solving complex client reporting and reconciliation challenges**

**• Driven to ensure data integrity and consistency across channels and transaction types, with aligned definitions, mappings, balances, references and reconciliation outcomes that clients can trust.**  
**• Building a coherent omnichannel experience across S2B Web, H2H, SWIFT and API**  
**• Leading collaboratively in regulated, globally distributed environments**

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Key Experiences**  
**• Typically 10+ years of relevant experience in transaction banking, cash management, corporate digital channels, data/reporting products or complex banking technology delivery.**  
**• Demonstrated Product Owner or Product Manager experience owning strategy, roadmap, backlog and end-to-end delivery for enterprise digital products.**  
**• Strong domain experience in corporate account information, statements, transaction reporting, advices or cash-management reporting across Web, H2H, SWIFT and/or API channels.**  
**• Practical experience with SWIFT account reporting and ISO 20022 cash-management messages; familiarity with MT940/942 and camt.052/053/054 is strongly preferred.**  
**• Experience translating data flows, source-to-target mappings, reconciliation rules and complex integrations into product requirements and client outcomes.**  
**• Track record of leading cross-functional delivery, UAT, releases, migrations, production incident remediation and lifecycle rationalisation in a regulated environment.**  
**• Strong analytical capability using product telemetry and client usage data; working knowledge of SQL, Power BI or Tableau is advantageous.**  
**• Experience influencing senior stakeholders and globally distributed teams without direct authority.**  
**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory)**  
**• Degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related discipline.**  
**• Product Owner, Agile or Scrum certification is advantageous, not mandatory.**  
**• SWIFT, ISO 20022, cash-management or data-management training/certification is advantageous.**  
**Languages**  
**• Professional fluency in English; additional market languages are advantageous where relevant to the role scope.**

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

**We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.**

**Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.**

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation** **, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.**
* **In line with our Fair Pay Charter** **, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.**
* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance** **, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.**
* **Time-off** **including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.**
* **Flexible working** **options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.**
* **Proactive wellbeing support** **through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.**
* **A continuous learning culture** **to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.**

**Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.**

author: Hiring Manager
title: Sr Product manager
job_description:
**About us:**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritise relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

**Target Global Supply Chain and Logistics** is evolving at an incredible pace. We are constantly reimagining how we get the right product to the guest even better, faster and more cost effectively than before. We are becoming more intelligent, automated and algorithmic in our decision-making, so that no matter how guests shop—in stores or on Target.com—we deliver the convenience and immediate gratification they demand and deserve. We are on a mission to win decisively over any competitor, with a seamless and superior guest service experience unlike any they can offer. Our teams work with the agility our mission requires, and we constantly come together to implement new processes in record time. So we’re looking for exceptional people who are proactive, creative, independent, innovative, risk-savvy and comfortable working in varying degrees of ambiguity. Are you a critical thinker who seeks the root cause and can analyse both qualitatively and quantitatively? Are you a creative problem-solver who simplifies problems, quickly identifies solutions, commits to a plan and then positively influences others to execute it? If so, you will have success on one of our dynamic teams.

**About the Job:**

The Senior Product Manager - Inventory Purchasing and Positioning is responsible for executing the strategy and this role will lead the product design, delivery of modern inventory systems. Our team and products enable the ability for Inventory Management teams to effectively manage the synchronized flow of inventory into and throughout Target's supply chain network. This role will work closely with supply chain product/business partners, enterprise capacity planning and data science teams. This role will act as the subject matter expert (SME) for the engineering teams and lead the development of the prioritized features along with systematic scale and performance enhancements to support business growth.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will collaborate with your product team and key stakeholders to develop a plan and business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to build a strong knowledge of your product through product discovery to collect customer feedback and work to collect other relevant data points that explain the value and help you prioritise the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will work in unison with engineers, operations, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product.

You will be the “voice of the product” with your product team and stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and you will be responsible to maintain and refine the product backlog (create user stories & acceptance criteria) while prioritising the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders. You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**Reporting/Working Relationships**

* Reports to Director, Product Management
* Located at Target India.
* Working Relationships: Works closely with Target Tech engineering teams and business product teams in India and United States, Global Supply Chain & Logistics, Digital, Stores, Target Finance and Accounting, enterprise capacity planning and Data Science

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s Degree
* 8+ years Supply chain experience
* 3+ years’ experience with Purchasing and Positioning
* 4+ years’ experience working in product and agile model
* Knowledge of Procurement – First mile, Replenishment, Order Management, Optimization/Sub optimization, TMS, WMS, Carrier Labeling and interactions
* Knowledge of B2B interactions (EDI, XML, APIs)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong business, technology and data acumen with interest towards AI/ML solutions.
* Strong communication skills w/ proven ability to communicate across business and technology teams as well as different levels of leadership.

**Know More About Us here:**

* **Life at Target**: https://india.target.com/
* **Benefits**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/workplace/benefits
* **Culture**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/belonging
* **Target** **Tech**: https://tech.target.com/

title: Product Manager II
job_description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**About Tekion**  
  
Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform. Our platform spans the Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, the Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises, and the Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform, using cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to bring together vehicle manufacturers, dealerships, and consumers. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia, and Europe.
  
  
**About the Role**
  
  
Tekion connects dealerships - the businesses that sell and service vehicles - with the automakers that build those vehicles, such as General Motors, Honda, or Ford. Across the industry these automakers are referred to as OEMs (Original Equipment Manufacturers). The software on each side needs to exchange information automatically and reliably: vehicle orders, inventory, repair records, customer details, and much more. The software that makes this exchange happen is called integration. We are seeking a driven, technically curious Product Manager I to join our Integrations team. You will take ownership of one integration pattern - a family of similar integrations that share the same shape (for example, all the integrations that send vehicle service and repair data to automakers). Your mission is to make every integration in that family measurably healthy and best-in-class, shift more of its delivery from manual building to AI-assisted building, and make sure dealerships actually adopt and benefit from it. This is a hands-on role for an early-career product manager who is comfortable with technical concepts, motivated by measurable outcomes, and excited to help modernize how a decades-old industry connects its software. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and senior product managers, who will guide and mentor you as you grow into full ownership of your integration pattern.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Who We Are

Bidgely (which means "electricity" in Hindi) is an AI-powered SaaS Company accelerating a clean energy future by enabling energy companies and consumers to make data-driven energy-related decisions.

Ranked #7 in Applied AI on Fast Company’s list of Most Innovative Companies in the World, Bidgely is putting customers at the center of the clean energy future

.

What We Do

Powered by our unique patented technology, Bidgely's UtilityAITM Platform transforms multiple dimensions of customer data - such as energy consumption, demographics, and interactions into deeply accurate and actionable consumer energy insights. We leverage these insights to empower each customer with personalized recommendations tailored to their individual personality and lifestyle, usage attributes, behavioral patterns, purchase propensity and beyond.

How We Do It

From a distributed energy resources (DER) and grid edge perspective, Bidgely is advancing smart meter innovation with data-driven solutions for solar PVs, electric vehicle (EV) detection, EV behavioral load shifting and managed charging, energy theft, short-term load forecasting, grid analytics and time of use (TOU) rate designs. Bidgely’s UtilityAITM energy analytics provides deep visibility into generation and consumption for better peak load shaping and grid planning and delivers targeted recommendations for new value-added products and services.

For more information, please visit-

Website: www.bidgely.com

Blog: bidgely.com/blog

How You Fit In

You will act as the GM of your problem space, balancing customer empathy, product excellence, and business impact. You are data-obsessed, have a bias-to-action, and fluent in transforming insights into scalable CX outcomes. Standout candidates will be AI-native—comfortable articulating an ML-powered alue proposition and using GenAI tools for speed and scale.

You will work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, with responsibility for the end-to-end product lifecycle, from roadmap and design to launch and enablement.

What You’ll Do

* Own a customer problem area end‐to‐end: define the vision, strategy, metrics, and delivery to the market; shape a 6-12‐month roadmap.
* Discover & prioritize through market analysis, customer interviews, data mining, and experiment results.
* Write & drive clear PRDs/specs; partner with Design Team to deliver accessible, intuitive UX across channels.
* Collaborate with Engineering & Data Science to ship solutions incrementally, including data

integrations, data engines, multi-application channel UX

* Measure outcomes (adoption, CSAT/NPS, call deflection, savings, reliability SLOs); run A/B tests;
* Enable GTM with crisp positioning, packaging, and launch plans; support client success and pre‐sales narratives.
* Represent the product with utility clients, regulators, and internal execs; communicate trade‐offs & decisions in writing.

What Makes You Successful

* 4–7+ years in Product Management with SaaS + data/analytics; 2+ years owning a CX/engagement or data‐driven product.
* Strong technical fluency: read APIs, reason about data models, eventing, and privacy/consent implications. Comfort working with data scientists, engineers, and non-technical customers alike.
* Proven strategy execution muscle: experience in shipping multi‐quarter roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and scalable processes.
* Facility with experimentation and product analytics; comfort with funnels, cohorts, and AB testing.
* Excellent writing & stakeholder leadership; can align execs and clients around trade‐offs.
* Domain bonus: utilities/energy (DSM/DR, TOU rates, DER/EV/solar), CSR tooling, or regulated industries.

Nice to Have

* Experience with load disaggregation or energy analytics; GenAI applications in CX and internal tooling.
* Working with enterprise buyers, procurements, and security/compliance reviews.

Core Competencies

* Product Visionary – Connects customer needs, data insights, and business growth to a cohesive product direction.
* Bias for Action – Turns insights into results in days and weeks, not quarters.
* Data‐Driven Storyteller – Uses data and experimentation to inform judgment, trade‐offs, and

prioritization.

* Polished Communicator – Crafts clear narratives for executives, cross‐functional peers, and

customers.

* Hands‐On Technical Aptitude – Understands APIs, models, and AI tools; can prototype or debug to unblock progress.
* Customer‐Centric Leader – Demonstrates empathy for end users and utility partners alike.
* Team Leader – Builds collaboration, motivates cross‐functional teams, and raises the product bar.

Why Join Bidgely?

* Shape the future of clean energy. Your work will directly influence how millions of customers

experience, understand, and participate in the energy transition — from electrification and EVs to smarter home engagement.

* Build at scale, backed by real impact. Bidgely’s platform already analyzes billions of energy data points daily; you’ll lead initiatives that amplify that reach through data, AI, and design.
* Join a global, high-caliber team. Collaborate with passionate engineers, designers, data scientists, and utility innovators across Silicon Valley, India, and Europe — all driven by a shared mission to decarbonize intelligently.
* Thrive in a culture of ownership and innovation. Expect autonomy, transparency, and a bias for action — we value ideas over hierarchy and results over noise.
* Grow your craft and your career. With access to cutting-edge GenAI tools, continuous learning opportunities, and visible impact across markets, you’ll have the runway to evolve as a product leader and shape the next chapter of UtilityAITM.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Equal Opportunity

At Bidgely we’re on a mission to make a difference and build a workplace where every unique voice is heard and celebrated. Here, we believe that celebrating the unique backgrounds, perspectives and abilities of every employee makes an impact not only for our company internally but also for our clients, customers and community. We are an equal opportunity employer and believe that the inclusive atmosphere we build together will enable every person to grow, contribute and thrive. Our hiring decisions are based on your skills, talent, and passion – not on your background, gender, race, age, or the quirky way you dance at office parties.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
### **The Opportunity**

Sitetracker is on a mission to accelerate the transition to a fully connected and sustainable future. We are at an exciting phase of our product journey and are seeking a customer- and market-centric Sr. Product Manager to join our India R&D hub. In this role, you will deliver agent-first product leadership across core Sitetracker Central product lines including Project Central, Field Central, Finance Central, Agreement Central, Site Central, and GIS Link. At Sitetracker, our product leaders drive the value we provide to the market. This is an opportunity to take ownership of key product initiatives, work with agency, and make a significant impact on how our global customers plan, develop, build, and operate critical infrastructure assets.

### **What You'll Do**

As a Sr. Product Manager at Sitetracker, you will hit the ground running and make an immediate impact by anchoring product leadership in our India R&D hub. Taking an agent-first approach across our Sitetracker Central product lines (Project Central, Field Central, Finance Central, Agreement Central, Site Central, or GIS Link), you will partner closely with customers to uncover high-value investment opportunities and guide features through the NPI process. You will build deep domain insights across critical infrastructure sectors (telecom, mobile towers, EV charging, data centers) while driving alignment directly with India Product Design and Engineering squads. With strong agency and a sharp focus on prioritization, you will manage initiatives from concept to execution translating complex enterprise problems into clear goals, measurable North Star metrics, and scalable automated workflows that accelerate customer value and market adoption.

### **The Skills You’ll Have**

#### **Domain Expertise**

* Deep domain understanding of critical infrastructure sectors, including telecom, mobile towers, EV charging networks, and data centers
* Strong background in production tracking, project controls, asset management, and geospatial/GIS integrations
* Ability to leverage industry terminology and domain insights to effectively communicate with customer executives and operational stakeholders

#### **Product Discovery**

* Identify, uncover, and validate critical customer problems and strategic market opportunities through targeted discovery methodologies
* Demonstrate mastery across a diverse range of qualitative and quantitative user research techniques, behavioral telemetry, and market analysis
* Excellence in customer interviewing, engaging buyer and user personas fluently using industry-specific domain terminology
* Continuously validate problem spaces to differentiate real customer friction from noise, establishing high-confidence business cases for product investment

#### **Roadmap & Prioritization**

* Prioritize product investments based rigorously on value delivered, strategic vision alignment, feasibility, and technical delivery risk
* Build scalable commercial business models and ROI justifications that align directly with proposed product investments and platform expansion
* Define clear North Star metrics, measurable outcome-based KPIs, and concrete success criteria for every product initiative
* Develop comprehensive product positioning strategies and collateral that articulate distinct value propositions across target market segments
* Execute constant and consistent post-launch validation of investments to ensure key outcomes, adoption targets, and customer value goals are achieved
* Maintain roadmap transparency while managing short-term market commitments against long-term strategic core capabilities

#### **Collaboration & Stakeholders**

* Lead cross-functional alignment effectively across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, Architecture, and Product Design to drive unified execution
* Confidently communicate priorities, product strategy, and trade-offs to internal leadership as well as external executive customer stakeholders
* Act with agency and strong ownership to foster collaborative relationships between global product squads and regional implementation teams

#### **Requirements Definition**

* Author detailed, high-rigor Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) capturing functional workflows, technical dependencies, and user stories
* Deconstruct complex enterprise problems into incremental, high-value release packages that accelerate time-to-market
* Align feature capabilities with specific buyer and user personas to refine the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)
* Conduct thorough competitive analysis and counter-positioning strategies to maximize market adoption and product differentiation
* Partner closely with engineering to ensure technical execution matches business requirements while maintaining zero ambiguity

### **Within 90 Days, You’ll**

* Become familiar with our internal tools, Product Playbook, and NPI processes while establishing working relationships with cross-functional teams in India and globally.
* Gain technical and functional domain expertise across Sitetracker Central product lines (Project Central, Field Central, Finance Central, Agreement Central, Site Central, or GIS Link).
* Achieve Sitetracker Certification to master the entire product suite and effectively articulate the core value proposition and customer business outcomes.
* Inherit the product roadmap for your assigned Central product area and begin collaborating directly with India Product Design and Engineering squads to align execution with product strategy.
* Initiate initial targeted customer discovery conversations to understand key industry friction points and domain terminology across telecom, EV charging, data centers, or mobile towers.

### **Within 180 Days, You’ll**

* Establish direct, ongoing discovery loops with executive customer stakeholders and operational users using quantitative telemetry and qualitative interviews.
* Serve as the primary product owner and partner for India Product Design and Engineering teams, guiding agent-first capabilities into clear, high-rigor Product Requirement Documents (PRDs).
* Develop a 1-year prioritized roadmap for your Sitetracker Central product line, balancing strategic value, technical feasibility, business outcomes, and delivery risks.
* Drive delivery on initial roadmap initiatives through active NPI process participation and milestone execution.
* Align global cross-functional partners (Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing) behind core feature positioning and release milestones

### **Within 365 Days, You’ll**

* Lead the end-to-end NPI process for major product investments across Sitetracker Central product lines, taking initiatives seamlessly from initial problem discovery to market adoption.
* Embed an agent-first approach into product development workflows, delivering scalable automation and workflow capabilities across complex customer business problems.
* Establish measurable ROI, North Star KPIs, and business impact for launched capabilities while conducting post-launch validation to refine ongoing strategy.
* Serve as a recognized domain authority and product leader within Sitetracker, fostering seamless cross-functional alignment between India R&D engineering teams and global go-to-market stakeholders.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager I
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager - Search & Analytics Platform**

  

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the data, query, and context foundations that help customers and AI agents understand and act on operational and security telemetry.

Effective investigation depends on finding the right data, querying it efficiently, and understanding how it relates to the customer's environment. As AI agents take on more analytical work, they need dependable access to telemetry and context: which service an entity belongs to, what it depends on, who owns it, and what changed. This role owns the shared platform capabilities that make that possible across observability, security, and platform optimization.

You will own established search and analytics capabilities while building toward federated analytics and a richer customer context foundation. This is a technically deep role requiring first-hand experience with data platforms, search, or analytics products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into useful capabilities that teams can adopt.

**What You Will Own**

**The search and query platform.** Search and query capabilities, query language and analytical functions, partitions, views, and shared query services. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing analytical depth, ease of use, and cost for both human and agent workloads.

**Federated analytics.** Define how customers and agents query and correlate Sumo data with data in connected systems. Establish the use cases, supported analytical capabilities, and tradeoffs around data movement, freshness, performance, permissions, and cost, working closely with the teams responsible for integrations and access.

**Customer context and the knowledge graph.** Build the shared understanding of a customer's environment: entities, services, workloads, ownership, topology, and dependencies. Define how that context is assembled from telemetry, metadata, and connected systems, how relationships are maintained, and how the accumulated context improves investigation and analysis over time.

**Data discovery and shared context services.** Help people and agents discover available sources, schemas, fields, and relationships, and retrieve the data and context relevant to a task. Own the shared capabilities that make this information reusable across product experiences, with clear provenance, freshness, and permission boundaries.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for the data and analytics platform, connecting current customer needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping query capabilities, partitions, and views, using customer feedback and workload data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, distributed analytics, scalability, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate federated analytics use cases, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.

job_description:
**InMobi (Corporate)**

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

**InMobi Advertising**

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

**Glance**

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

**About Accelerate:**  
Accelerate is InMobi's AI-native, self-serve campaign management platform for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies and enterprise advertisers. An advertiser describes their brand and goals; Accelerate's agents plan, create, launch and optimize campaigns across ad platforms such as TikTok and OpenAI, with more supply integrations on the way.  
We are building toward a fully autonomous marketing platform. This role sits on the demand side, reporting to the Group Product Manager for Customer Experience Core.  
  
**About the Role:**  
You will own Accelerate's growth engine: getting every advertiser from first visit to a live, performing campaign, and keeping them coming back. This is a Growth PM role with full ownership of user and retention metrics. You will design the journey for each persona, from an SMB owner who has never run an ad to an agency moving dozens of accounts from another tool. You will own signup, ad-account connection, migration of existing accounts and spend history, and the moments that turn a new user into an  
active one.You will run experiments, own the funnel numbers, and work closely with the Core Product Experience and Monetization teams, since activation depends on both a great first campaign and a smooth first payment.

**What you will own:**

* Persona journeys. End-to-end journeys for SMBs, D2C brands, agencies, mid-size advertisers and enterprise teams, from first visit to steady use. You define what "activated" means for each.
* Signup and account connection. Signup, business verification, connecting ad accounts on platforms like TikTok and OpenAI, and linking data sources such as pixels and product catalogs.
* Migration. Bringing existing ad accounts, campaigns and spend history into Accelerate, so advertisers keep their learnings and agencies can move clients in bulk.
* Activation. Time to first live campaign and first results. Includes AI-guided onboarding, where the agent helps users finish setup rather than leaving them with a checklist.
* Retention and lifecycle. Nudges, re-engagement, in-product guidance and email or WhatsApp lifecycle flows that bring users back and grow their usage.
* Experimentation. An experimentation practice for the funnel: hypotheses, A/B tests, analysis and decisions.
* Metrics. Signup-to-activation conversion, time to first live campaign, account connection success rate, week-4 and week-12 retention, and activation by persona and acquisition channel.

  

**What we're looking for:**

* 6+ years of product management, with at least 3 years as a Growth PM owning activation or retention metrics.
* Growth experience in a B2B or merchant-facing self-serve product (SMBs, sellers, restaurants, creators, developers). Consumer-only growth experience is not enough on its own.
* A track record of moving funnel metrics through experiments, with numbers you can explain: baseline, change, and why it worked.
* Strong analytical skills. You write your own SQL or work directly in product analytics tools, and you know when an experiment result is noise.
* Design sense for onboarding: you know how small details in a flow change conversion, and you partner with design as a peer.
* You work AI-native (see "How we work" below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
* Clear written communication and the ability to align engineering, design, marketing and customer success around a funnel goal.

**Strong pluses:**

* Experience with ad-platform account linking, OAuth integrations, or migrating users and data from a competing product.
* Built AI-guided or conversational onboarding in production.
* Experience with agency or multi-account onboarding.
* Experience with lifecycle tools and channels (email, push, WhatsApp) and the experimentation platforms behind them.
* Experience in martech or adtech, or time running performance marketing yourself.

**How we work:**  
Accelerate is an AI-native product, and we build it the AI-native way. Every PM on the demand side is expected to:

* Prototype before you spec. Turn an idea into a clickable prototype with AI tools in hours, and test it with users and the team before writing requirements.
* Write and think with LLMs. Draft PRDs, edge cases, test cases, and analyses with an LLM as a working partner. Then apply your own judgment to what it gets wrong.
* Hand off with less back-and-forth. Give engineering and design specs precise enough to build from, with prototypes and acceptance criteria attached, so fewer decisions get made in meetings.
* Stay close to the data. Pull and analyze data yourself rather than waiting on a dashboard request.
* Bring design sense. Care about the details of the customer experience and partner with design as a peer, not a requester. We will test this in the interview loop, not just ask about it.

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

Find out more here: InMobi Culture

**About the role:**  
You will build Accelerate's payments and money infrastructure from zero. Every dollar or rupee an advertiser puts into Accelerate flows through what you build: how they fund their account, how spend is drawn down across ad platforms, how they are invoiced, refunded and taxed, and how we settle with suppliers.  
There is no legacy system to inherit. You will define the wallet, the ledger behind it, and the integration with our third-party payments partner (Vyre), then own the revenue metrics that depend on them. Getting this right is what lets an SMB go from signup to live campaign in minutes, and what lets finance trust every number on the dashboard.  
You will work with a Senior Product Associate on the pod, engineering, Central Design, and InMobi finance, tax and legal teams.

**What you will own:**

* Advertiser wallet. A prepaid balance advertisers top up and Accelerate draws down as campaigns spend. Includes funding methods, auto-recharge, low-balance alerts, credit lines for larger accounts, and the rules for how a balance can and cannot be used.
* Ledger and reconciliation. The source of truth for every credit, debit, hold, refund and adjustment. Spend reported by each ad platform must reconcile to the ledger, with clear handling for mismatches.
* Payments integration. End-to-end integration with Vyre, our third-party payments partner: collections, payment methods, failures and retries, webhooks, and the fallback plan if a provider is down.
* Billing, invoicing and tax. Invoices, receipts, GST, TDS on ad spend, and multi-currency handling as we add international advertisers.
* Supplier settlement. How we pay out and reconcile with ad platforms, working with the business team that handles supplier contracts.
* Segment needs. SMBs prepaying by card or UPI, agencies funding many client accounts from one place, and enterprise clients on invoiced terms.
* Revenue metrics. Top-up conversion, payment success rate, time to first funded campaign, wallet balance retention, and reconciliation accuracy. Every revenue number in Accelerate's success framework depends on your system.

**What we're looking for:**

* 6+ years of product management, with at least 3 years owning payments, wallets, billing or ledger systems.
* You have built a payments or wallet system from scratch, or led its first major version. Scaling a mature system alone is not enough.
* Deep understanding of double-entry ledgers, idempotency, reconciliation, refunds and chargebacks. You can sit with engineers and discuss failure modes, not just flows.
* Hands-on experience integrating a third-party payment provider or aggregator end to end.
* Working knowledge of Indian payments regulation and tax: RBI rules on prepaid instruments, GST, TDS. You know when to bring in legal and what to ask them.
* You work AI-native (see "How we work" below). You prototype, write and reason with LLMs as part of your daily work.
* Clear written communication. You can explain a ledger design to an engineer, a finance controller and an SMB owner, each in their own terms.  
  Strong pluses
* You built a wallet or stored-balance feature inside a non-fintech product, such as a marketplace, mobility, food delivery or SaaS platform.
* Experience with ad-platform billing (prepaid, postpaid or credit-line models) or marketplace payouts.
* Experience with cross-border payments, multi-currency balances or FX.
* Experience with B2B billing for agencies or multi-entity accounts.
* Some time as an engineer, or comfort reading API docs and querying data directly.

job_description:
**Senior Product Manager / Staff Product Manager – AI & Intelligent Systems**

**Experience:** 6–12 Years

**Build the Next Generation of Production-Grade AI Products!**

Are you excited about building AI products that go beyond integrating LLM APIs and conventional AI features?

We are looking for a technically strong **Senior Product Manager – AI** to own the vision and development of intelligent, AI-native products. You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering and AI/ML to solve complex problems, build scalable AI systems and take them from 0-to-1 experimentation to production deployment.

This is an opportunity to shape products powered by LLMs, AI agents and intelligent automation, with real-world impact at scale.

***What You'll Do***

* **Own AI Product Strategy:** Define product vision, roadmap and execution for complex AI-powered products from 0-to-1.
* **Build Production-Grade AI Systems:** Drive AI capabilities beyond POCs into reliable, scalable systems used by real customers.
* **Drive LLM & Agentic AI Products:** Build products involving LLMs, AI agents, multi-agent workflows, tool calling and orchestration.
* **Influence Technical Architecture:** Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on system design, APIs, microservices, data pipelines and integrations.
* **Own AI Quality & Evaluation:** Define evaluation frameworks, golden datasets, accuracy benchmarks and continuous feedback loops.
* **Optimise AI Performance:** Drive improvements in model accuracy, latency, cost, reliability and scalability.
* **Lead Cross-Functional Execution:** Translate complex problems into product requirements and drive delivery across Engineering, AI/ML and Design.

***What We're Looking For***

* 6–12 years of experience in Product Management, with strong ownership of technically complex products.
* Proven experience building and scaling **AI/ML-powered products or LLM-based systems**.
* Strong understanding of **Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, Agentic Workflows and RAG**.
* Experience taking AI capabilities from experimentation to **production deployment at scale**.
* Strong technical understanding of **distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture and data pipelines**.
* Understanding of **LLM evaluation, model performance, accuracy, monitoring and optimisation**.
* Ability to work closely with engineering teams on architecture, technical specifications and complex trade-offs.
* Strong product thinking, customer discovery, problem-solving and execution skills.

***Good to Have***

* Experience building AI-native products or agentic AI platforms from scratch.
* Exposure to LangGraph, LangChain, vector databases and LLM orchestration frameworks.
* Familiarity with AI observability, model evaluation and automated testing.
* Experience working with applied AI research or ML engineering teams.

Why Join?

* Build cutting-edge AI products beyond conventional AI integrations.
* Solve challenging problems involving LLMs, agents and intelligent systems.
* Own products end-to-end, from strategy and architecture to production adoption.
* Work closely with strong Engineering and AI/ML teams.
* Create products designed for real-world scale, reliability and impact.

**If you are passionate about turning complex AI capabilities into production-grade products, we would love to hear from you!**

Pay: ₹6,000,000.00 - ₹8,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What is your current CTC Breakup ( Fixed + Variable + Stocks)

Experience:

* Agentic AI : 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

Product

**Senior Product Manager**
--------------------------

Full-Time 8+ Years

Senior Product Manager

**About Milestone**

Milestone Inc. is a leading AI-first Digital Experience and Marketing Platform company helping enterprises create, manage, optimize, and amplify their digital presence across web, search, local, voice, and AI-driven discovery channels.
  
  
Our platform powers digital experiences for global brands across hospitality, retail, automotive, healthcare, banking, and other multi-location enterprises. With over 25 years of innovation, Milestone combines AI, SEO, CMS, analytics, content intelligence, and omnichannel engagement into a unified SaaS platform trusted by thousands of businesses globally.
  
  
We are building the next generation of AI-native digital experience products that redefine how brands create discoverable, personalized, and conversion-focused experiences in the GenAI era.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly strategic and execution-oriented Senior Product Manager / Product Manager - CMS & Digital Experience Platform to drive the evolution of Milestone's AI-first CMS and Digital Experience capabilities.
  
  
This role requires a product leader who can deeply understand enterprise customer problems, market trends, AI-led content evolution, SEO/GEO dynamics, Personalization, and modern web experience requirements while partnering closely with Engineering, Design, GTM, Customer Success, and Enterprise Customers.
  
  
You will own product strategy, roadmap prioritization, customer outcomes, adoption metrics, Customer communication, and feature execution for our next-generation CMS platform.

***Problems We Are Looking to Solve***

* Enterprise-scale AI-driven content management
* Discoverability across Search and Generative AI ecosystems
* AI-powered content optimization and governance
* SEO/GEO-native digital experiences
* Conversion-focused, hyper-personalized customer journeys

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Vision & Leadership**

* Define and execute product vision and roadmap\

* Drive AI-first product innovation

* Conduct market and competitive analysis

* Translate customer pain points into scalable solutions

* Understand customer churn and derive strategies to reduce future churn

**Operational Excellence & Growth**

* Own product lifecycle from ideation to launch

* Create PRDs, user stories, and documentation

* Drive roadmap execution with Engineering teams

* Monitor adoption, engagement, and retention KPIs

**Innovation & Culture**

* Champion AI-native product thinking

* Foster innovation and accountability culture

* Evangelize product capabilities internally and externally

* Stay ahead of CMS, Digital asset management and AI trends

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Collaborate with Engineering, UX, Marketing, Sales, and CS teams

* Partner with Product Marketing for GTM initiatives

* Support enterprise sales cycles and customer workshops

**Customer Impact**

* Act as voice of the customer

* Improve customer adoption and success outcomes

* Ensure measurable business impact

**Talent & Empowerment**

* Mentor junior product team members

* Promote ownership and continuous learning

* Strengthen product management best practices
  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a customer-centric product leader with strong experience in B2B SaaS platforms, CMS technologies, AI-led digital experiences, and enterprise-scale product management.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 8+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS

* Experience with CMS, Digital Experience Platforms, or Martech

* Strong understanding of APIs and modern web architectures

* Experience collaborating with Engineering and Design teams

* Strong analytical and communication skills

**Key Focus Areas**

* AI-native CMS innovation

* SEO/GEO-first digital experiences

* Enterprise content scalability

* Product-led growth and adoption

**Capabilities**

1. Product Strategy & Roadmapping
  
2. Enterprise SaaS Product Management
  
3. AI-first Product Thinking
  
4. Agile Product Development
  
5. Customer Discovery & Validation
  
6. Data-Driven Decision Making
  
7. Stakeholder Management
  
8. GTM Collaboration

**KPI and Metrics**

1. Product Adoption
  
2. Customer Engagement & Retention
  
3. Time-to-Market
  
4. Customer Satisfaction
  
5. Platform Performance
  
6. Revenue Influence
  
7. Product Usage Growth
  
8. Customer Success Outcomes

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field

* MBA preferred

* Product or Agile certifications are a plus

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation and incentives

* Opportunity to build AI-first products

* Exposure to global enterprise customers

* Career growth and leadership opportunities

* Collaborative and innovative culture

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter outlining their qualifications and vision for the role plus previous experience align with key attributes, responsibilities, clear wins or learnings.

  

**Why Milestone**

* AI-first Digital Experience Platform

* SEO/GEO-native CMS leadership

* Founder-led innovation culture
